data.subject: Public-record research for Pacific Ridge
data.body:
Hi,

Pacific Ridge's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in two listed tickers: PKBK and ALCO.

On September 24, PKBK disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1315399/000143774926031135/pkbk20260923_8k.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
